# awscc_glue_table (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Glue::Table



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_id` (String) The ID of the Data Catalog in which to create the Table.
- `database_name` (String) The name of the database where the table metadata resides. For Hive compatibility, this must be all lowercase.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The table name. For Hive compatibility, this is folded to lowercase when it is stored.
- `open_table_format_input` (Attributes) Specifies an OpenTableFormatInput structure when creating an open format table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_table_format_input))
- `table_input` (Attributes) A structure used to define a table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--open_table_format_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_table_format_input`

Optional:

- `iceberg_input` (Attributes) Specifies an IcebergInput structure that defines an Apache Iceberg metadata table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_table_format_input--iceberg_input))

<a id="nestedatt--open_table_format_input--iceberg_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `open_table_format_input.iceberg_input`

Optional:

- `iceberg_table_input` (Attributes) Specifies the Iceberg table configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_table_format_input--iceberg_input--iceberg_table_input))
- `metadata_operation` (String) A required metadata operation. Can only be set to CREATE.
- `version` (String) The table version of the Iceberg table. Defaults to 2.

<a id="nestedatt--table_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_input`

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the table.
- `name` (String) The table name. For Hive compatibility, this is folded to lowercase when it is stored.
- `owner` (String) The table owner. Included for Apache Hive compatibility. Not used in the normal course of AWS Glue operations.
- `parameters` (String) These key-value pairs define properties associated with the table.
- `partition_keys` (Attributes List) A list of columns by which the table is partitioned. Only primitive types are supported as partition keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--partition_keys))
- `retention` (Number) The retention time for this table.
- `storage_descriptor` (Attributes) A storage descriptor containing information about the physical storage of this table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor))
- `table_type` (String) The type of this table. AWS Glue will create tables with the EXTERNAL_TABLE type. Other services, such as Athena, may create tables with additional table types.
- `target_table` (Attributes) A TableIdentifier structure that describes a target table for resource linking. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--target_table))
- `view_definition` (Attributes) The view definition for the table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--view_definition))
- `view_expanded_text` (String) Included for Apache Hive compatibility. Not used in the normal course of AWS Glue operations.
- `view_original_text` (String) Included for Apache Hive compatibility. Not used in the normal course of AWS Glue operations.

<a id="nestedatt--table_input--partition_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_input.partition_keys`

Optional:

- `comment` (String) A free-form text comment.
- `name` (String) The name of the Column.
- `type` (String) The data type of the Column.


<a id="nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_input.storage_descriptor`

Optional:

- `bucket_columns` (List of String) A list of reducer grouping columns, clustering columns, and bucketing columns in the table.
- `columns` (Attributes List) A list of the Columns in the table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--columns))
- `compressed` (Boolean) True if the data in the table is compressed, or False if not.
- `input_format` (String) The input format: SequenceFileInputFormat (binary), or TextInputFormat, or a custom format.
- `location` (String) The physical location of the table. By default, this takes the form of the warehouse location, followed by the database location in the warehouse, followed by the table name.
- `number_of_buckets` (Number) Must be specified if the table contains any dimension columns.
- `output_format` (String) The output format: SequenceFileOutputFormat (binary), or IgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat, or a custom format.
- `parameters` (String) The user-supplied properties in key-value form.
- `schema_reference` (Attributes) An object that references a schema stored in the AWS Glue Schema Registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--schema_reference))
- `serde_info` (Attributes) The serialization/deserialization (SerDe) information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--serde_info))
- `skewed_info` (Attributes) The information about values that appear frequently in a column (skewed values). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--skewed_info))
- `sort_columns` (Attributes List) A list specifying the sort order of each bucket in the table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--sort_columns))
- `stored_as_sub_directories` (Boolean) True if the table data is stored in subdirectories, or False if not.

<a id="nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_input.storage_descriptor.columns`

Optional:

- `comment` (String) A free-form text comment.
- `name` (String) The name of the Column.
- `type` (String) The data type of the Column.


<a id="nestedatt--table_input--storage_descriptor--schema_reference"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_input.storage_descriptor.schema_reference`

Optional:

- `schema_version_number` (Number) The version number of the schema.

- `schema_name` (String) The name of the schema. One of SchemaArn or SchemaName has to be provided.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_glue_table.example
  identity = {
    catalog_id    = "catalog_id"
    database_name = "database_name"
    name          = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `catalog_id` (String) The ID of the Data Catalog in which to create the Table
- `database_name` (String) The name of the database where the table metadata resides
- `name` (String) The table name

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_glue_table.example
  id = "catalog_id|database_name|name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_glue_table.example "catalog_id|database_name|name"
```
